title: MediaOCD Announces Deal to Sell Select Aniplex of America Anime on Blu-ray Disc
content: MediaOCD announced on Wednesday a sales agreement with Aniplex of America to sell select anime on Blu-ray Disc on the MediaOCD online store. Initial Aniplex of America titles available on MediaOCD 's website are the Gurren Lagann television series and films, and the two seasons of the Mashle: Magic and Muscles anime.

title: Eva Marie Saint, Superman Returns & Legend of Korra Actress, Dead at 102
content: Eva Marie Saint, the iconic actress from Hollywood’s golden era, has passed away. Reps for the actress confirmed to Deadline that she died at her home in Los Angeles, “surrounded by family and loved ones.” They confirmed that Saint died of natural causes. She was 102.

title: Black Clover Season 2 Episode 2 Preview and Synopsis Revealed
content: Black Clover Season 2 has released preview images and synopsis for Episode 2 (Episode 172 overall) ahead of its October 10 premiere. The new season officially began on October 3, 2026 , with Crunchyroll streaming it worldwide.
author: Anime Corner

title: Kagurabachi Anime Casts Yuichi Nakamura as Soshiro Azami, New Character Trailer and Visual Revealed
content: KAGURABACHI anime has cast Yuichi Nakamura as Soshiro Azami, introducing the character with a new visual and dedicated trailer. Nakamura’s casting joins the previously announced main cast ahead of the anime’s April 2027 premiere.
author: Anime Corner

title: Exclusive: Viz Hosts Signing Tour for GalaXic Baseball League Comic Artist Acky Bright
content: Viz Media announced on Wednesday a signing tour across the United States for the GalaXic Baseball League comic series — Viz's collaboration with MLB Players, Inc., OneTeam Partners, and the BW NYC Studios of Japanese artist Acky Bright. The tour will start on October 13, the release date of the comic's first volume.
author: ANN

title: Walking Home with You Anime Unveils April 2027 TV Debut
content: The official website for the anime of Mai Matsuda 's Walking Home with You ( Hōkago Kitaku Biyori ) manga opened on Wednesday and confirmed the anime's television format. The website also unveiled the anime's teaser visual and April 2027 premiere on the NTV channel.
author: ANN
